initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed difference is 0.1 − 0.5 = −0.4. The reported checks verify arithmetic, but do not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R290-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R290-2 establishes random assignment independent of potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference, identifying the causal effect by the observed risk difference. The exact population risks are 1/10 and 20/40, so E[Y(1)] − E[Y(0)] = 0.1 − 0.5 = −0.4.
